$description: BIM TENANT MIX token category — expected distribution of tenant furniture-configuration sizes and use-type categories across a Professional Centre or Suburban Office floor plate. Used for FFE procurement planning and Tile composition optimisation. Source: CONSTRUCTION_2026_01_06_Tear Sheet_Floor Plans_Key Plans_Methodology_FIN.xlsx. Moved here from floor-plate-standards.dtcg.json (2026-07-03) per tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md §6 — tenant-mix distributions are inputs to the floor-plate solver, not floor-plate geometry, and belong in their own token file.

furniture-availability.$description: Expected distribution of furniture configuration sizes across the tenant mix. Used for FFE procurement planning and Tile composition optimisation.

small.$description: 80% — majority of tenant fit-outs use small furniture configurations. Drives Private Office and small Professional Office tile prevalence.

large.$description: 10% — large furniture configuration tenant mix; typically Corporate Office full-floor tenants.

use-type-distribution.$description: Expected distribution of tenant use-type category across the tenant mix. Used by tool-floorplates when no explicit tenant-mix request is supplied, to project a representative floor plate composition. Source: tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md §6 (2026-05-17, Opus agent research).

private.$description: 40% — Private Office leaseholds (individual licensed offices, PO-1/PO-2/PO-3).

professional.$description: 35% — Professional Office leaseholds across all sub-types (Medical, Business, Laboratory, Academic, Civic).

corporate.$description: 25% — Corporate Office leaseholds (single-tenant tiles up to full floor).
